item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine and hot weather to the coast of southern China tomorrow. Super Typhoon Mawar now over the western North Pacific is expected to move towards the seas east of Luzon in the next couple of days. There are uncertainties in the subsequent movement of Mawar. According to present forecast, there is a higher chance of Mawar turning northwards in the vicinity of the Luzon Strait and Taiwan. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, it will be very hot over southern China early to midweek next week. Showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Besides, there will be swells over the coastal waters.
